decisions.title: Which caption style?
decisions.question: Should captions be word-by-word highlighted, or whole sentences at the bottom of the frame?

options.text: Word-by-word highlight: lively, like short-video apps. Takes longer to export.
Whole sentences: calm and easy to read. Fast to export.

decisions.recommendation: A, because most viewers watch without sound.

decisions.title: Where do finished clips go?
decisions.question: Proposal: a local folder first, upload to the channel only after a spoken or typed yes.
decisions.ownerSaid: Sounds fine, but ask me before anything goes online.
